in_sanskrit.name: Balvir
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Powerful, Brave
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Balvir एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Balvir is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bal' meaning power and 'Vir' meaning hero. This name is bestowed upon a child with the hope that they will grow up to be a brave and powerful individual.
